prompt:
Create a production-ready square transparent game inventory icon atlas for the KUNLUN mountain martial sect. EXACTLY sixteen separate icons in an invisible, mathematically equal 4 by 4 grid, strict row-major order. Each cell contains one self-contained object or the explicitly described inseparable object set. Keep every object entirely within its cell with at least 15 percent empty margin on all four sides. Nothing crosses a cell boundary. No scene, no decorative backing, no borders, no frames, no grid lines, no lettering, no words, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no glowing aura. Book covers have ONLY abstract pictorial non-letter motifs. Hand-painted polished chibi wuxia prop art: watercolor and gouache texture, fine warm-brown outlines, readable rounded silhouettes, gentle upper-left lighting, modest soft highlights, muted ice blue and ochre with ivory paper and worn wood. Consistent 3/4 top-down object view and consistent visual scale. Each silhouette must be distinct, especially the ten manuscripts: use the specified varied bindings, folds, paper shapes, clips and wraps. Do not turn all books into identical rectangles. Transparent alpha background all around objects and between cells. Deliver the single square atlas, not a mockup.
Items in strict left-to-right top-to-bottom order (indices for placement only, NEVER write index on image):
1. Slim ice-blue clothbound sword manual, ochre stitching, embossed twin ridgelines and one small sword motif.
2. Ochre accordion-fold diagram with ice-blue edging, three ink mountains linked by angular sword-path marks.
3. Narrow ice-blue silk scroll on two ochre wooden rollers, unfolding cloud turns and a silver sword silhouette.
4. Half-curled pale stone rubbing, ochre wooden clamp, sharp sword grooves and sparse ice-blue annotations.
5. Small ochre soft-leather breathing book, ice-blue ribbon, single winding mountain path embossed on cover.
6. Thick ivory stitched book with ice-blue spine and three ochre leaf-shaped bookmarks fanning outward.
7. Rigid ice-blue book case with ochre-gold peak-shaped clasp and visible ivory page edges.
8. Narrow ochre folded route chart with ice-blue footprints along a ridge and a short hemp corner tie.
9. Fan-open ice-blue pivot-bound booklet, ochre rivet at one corner, curved footprint diagrams on pages.
10. Weathered ochre leather notebook with ice-blue patch, short charcoal pencil and folded slips tucked inside.
11. Slender silver-gray straight sword, ice-blue wrapped grip, ochre wooden scabbard with twin-peak bronze fitting.
12. Broad two-handed straight sword with long ochre grip, ice-blue guard cord and scuffed iron scabbard.
13. Ice-blue short mountain cape, ochre trim, layered standing collar and crossed fastening straps.
14. Ochre wooden twin-peak token with an ice-blue cord knot and a shallow record groove on the back.
15. Small stacked ochre travel cakes in waxed paper, ice-blue cloth wrap tied with thin hemp string.
16. Narrow ochre wooden map case with ice-blue cloud inlays, twin-peak sliding clasp and worn metal corners.
visual_review: 已以 view_image 逐格目視核對16件；劍法可辨直劍／劍路，拳掌可辨握拳／開掌，內功可辨冥想／經脈循環，輕功可辨足印／騰躍。秘籍為矩形書冊或矩形卷軸，兵器與服飾信物類型一致。全圖保留4×4原順序、完整剪影及寬透明間隔，無可讀文字、扇形秘籍或裁切。
edit_prompt: Edit this existing sixteen-icon atlas. Preserve all sixteen KUNLUN objects, their exact row-major order, materials, colors and hand-painted style. CRITICAL: rebuild the layout as a perfectly equal invisible 4x4 grid on a square transparent canvas, with each object centered at the EXACT center of its own square cell. REDUCE every object/set to at most 60% of its cell width AND 60% of its cell height. Thus EVERY cell has at least 20% completely empty transparent space on all four edges. All three full-width horizontal grid-divider strips and all three full-height vertical divider strips must be fully transparent, with substantial empty space around each. No part of any icon may enter any other cell. In the third row second column remove the writing-like scribbles from the notebook paper; replace with entirely blank ivory paper and a tiny non-letter dot motif. NO text, lettering, writing, labels, borders or visible grid lines anywhere. Do not add, remove or duplicate objects. Transparent background; same original sixteen items from the reference.

revision_prompt:
Edit this exact transparent 4 by 4 wuxia inventory atlas, preserving all sixteen item positions and row-major order. The goal is accurate, instantly recognizable inventory thumbnails; martial-arts manuals MUST look like bound rectangular books or rectangular scrolls, never handheld fans or unrelated props. Keep hand-painted gouache fantasy game icon style, fine brown outlines, 3/4 top-down view and original palette. Every object must occupy at most 70% of its equal-size cell with broad fully transparent padding on all four sides, complete silhouettes, clear horizontal and vertical transparent gutters, and no overlap or clipped edges. Keep icon centers x/y at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Preserve correct object designs except uniformly reducing size to fit these margins. No readable text, lettering, labels, digits, grid, borders, or background; only simple meaningful pictorial cover art. Transparent alpha output.
KUNLUN palette: icy blue, ochre leather, gold and ivory. EXACT CONTENTS BY ROW/COLUMN:
R1C1 KL001 Keep a rectangular blue sword-manual book with obvious long straight jian sword emblem and small mountain motif.
R1C2 KL002 Replace scenery-only accordion map with an open rectangular ochre book with blue binding. Both pages show two upright straight jian swords and interlocking curved sword-path arrows, meaning Two Principles Swordplay. Mountains may be tiny background motifs only.
R1C3 KL003 Keep a rectangular blue scroll with golden rollers and one obvious straight jian sword; add tiny lightning-shaped motion marks beside sword to suggest rapid swordplay.
R1C4 KL004 Replace irregular mountain rubbing with a proper rectangular ivory sword manual on blue cloth backing: big straight jian sword emblem with seven thin parallel zither-string lines and small sound-wave arcs, meaning Seven Strings Five Tones Sword.
R2C1 KL005 Ochre leather rectangular book with blue tie: replace mountain-road cover art with a seated meditating person silhouette with a clear circular breathing arrow around the chest and abdomen. Inner-energy manual, no feet or weapon.
R2C2 KL006 Ivory rectangular bound book, blue spine, ochre bookmarks: replace mountain imagery with front-view human torso diagram, blue meridian lines and gold circular energy-breathing arrows. Inner-energy manual.
R2C3 KL007 Blue hardbound rectangular book: replace mountain clasp and plain cover with a large two-tone yin-yang symbol encircled by energy-flow arrows, plus tiny meditating silhouette. Inner-energy manual, book not jewelry box.
R2C4 KL008 Keep narrow rectangular ochre folded footwork manuscript with blue footprints tracing a path.
R3C1 KL009 REMOVE all fan shape and pivot rivet. Replace with a clearly rectangular open blue-bound book showing two small leaping human silhouettes and sparse light footprints crossing a snowflake motif. A lightness/footwork book, absolutely NOT a fan.
R3C2 KL010 Keep ochre training notebook with blue patch and charcoal pencil; change blue patch's mountain emblem to a small straight jian and practice-route diagram so it reads as sword-practice notes.
R3C3 KL011 Keep the slender silver straight jian with blue grip and ochre scabbard, both fully inside its cell.
R3C4 KL012 Make this unmistakably a heavy TWO-HANDED training sword: long broad straight steel blade and distinctly long two-handed ochre grip, blue cord and sturdy dark sheath alongside. Clearly larger blade width and longer grip than previous ordinary jian; no dagger proportions.
R4C1 KL013 Keep short ice-blue cloak with ochre trim.
R4C2 KL014 Keep double-mountain-shaped wooden token and blue cord.
R4C3 KL015 Keep round journey flatbreads wrapped in ivory paper and blue cloth.
R4C4 KL016 Keep long narrow ochre wooden sword-manuscript case, adding one tiny straight-sword engraved emblem on the lid. Case does not contain a visible weapon.

FINAL LAYOUT PASS:
LAYOUT CORRECTION ONLY. Edit this transparent 4x4 inventory atlas. Keep all SIXTEEN item designs, all meaningful cover pictograms and exact row-major item order unchanged. The existing icons are TOO BIG. Redraw each entire item at only 60% of its current linear size, individually, placing it at the CENTER of its own equal square cell. This means every item silhouette must fit comfortably within the middle 55% of its cell width AND height. IMPORTANT: Shrink the entire heavy sword/scabbard set as well; shrink the entire open-book spread as one item. Give each item very broad empty transparent padding around all four sides. There must be uninterrupted wide transparent horizontal and vertical gutter bands at the quarter, half and three-quarter divisions. Exact equal grid centers: x and y 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Preserve the books' sword/palm/fist/meditation/footstep diagrams, weapons, garments, tokens, supplies, boxes, colors and hand-painted gouache texture. No objects may extend beyond their cell. Do not crop, omit, substitute, merge or add items. No readable text, no labels, no visible grid. Return the entire square atlas with real transparent alpha. Again: substantially SMALLER isolated icons, not large icons filling their cells.
